It's just another day at work for Lucina as she clocks in for her evening shift at Hooters. She heads to the break room to change into her snug uniform, adjusting the tank top to make sure it shows off just the right amount of cleavage. Looking in the mirror, she gives her butt a little wiggle in the short shorts and smiles. Time to make some tips!

Lucina grabs her notepad and pen, putting on a bubbly smile as she heads out to the floor. She greets some of her regulars by name, promising to stop by their table soon. As she passes a group of college guys, one playfully smacks her butt. She jumps a little and wags her finger with a grin, used to the flirty antics by now.

Making her rounds, Lucina takes orders and chats with customers. She laughs at lame jokes, accepts compliments graciously, and flirts just enough to get good tips. Her tank top dips down a bit, and she notices his eyes darting to her cleavage for just a second before he snaps back to attention with a chuckle. All according to plan!

Lucina is making her way around the restaurant, delivering food and taking more orders, when she spots two new customers being seated in her section. Her eyes go wide when she realizes it's her mom and dad! She hasn't told them she's working here yet, knowing her modest mother would not approve of the skimpy Hooters uniform.

Flushing bright red, Lucina grabs a menu and puts on her best smile as she approaches their table. "Mom! Dad! What a surprise to see you here!" she says, giving them both quick hugs. She notices her mom eyeing her tiny orange shorts and tight tank top critically.

"Uh, welcome to Hooters! Can I start you off with some drinks?" Lucina asks, trying to keep things professional. She shifts her weight from foot to foot, suddenly feeling very exposed in the snug uniform with her parents here. But she needs this job, and there's no use trying to hide it from them now. She just hopes her mom understands.
